test_token_classification_simple: test the token classification API endpoint with a simple text input string
test_token_classification_malformed: test the token classification API endpoint with malformed UTF-8 binary data
test_token_classification_json_input: test the token classification API by posting a JSON object with an inputs key
test_token_classification_raw_input: test the token classification API by posting a raw string as the request body
test_token_classification_response_schem: test that the token classification API response contains entity_group, word, start, end, and score keys
